Brand.title: NomosX — From Chaos to Nomos
Brand.description: NomosX is an autonomous think tank that transforms the chaos of information into scenario-weighted, source-verified positions — not opinions.
Brand.ogDescription: From Chaos to Nomos. Cross-domain scenario reasoning with verified positions.
Brand.heroSubtitle: The world doesn't suffer from a lack of information. It suffers from a lack of verifiable order.
Brand.manifesto:
The world doesn't suffer from a lack of information. It suffers from a lack of structure.

Knowledge without order creates noise. Order without verification creates opinion. Verification without scenarios creates hindsight. We bind all three.

That is NomosX.
Brand.mission: Strategic decisions are still made on single forecasts, opaque sources, and borrowed convictions. We built an institute that does better: map the evidence across every relevant domain, force the strongest counter-argument before any position stands, stress-test it against multiple futures, and publish the result — traceable, defensible, agenda-free.
Brand.philosophyStatement: The Nomos is not merely the law. It is the order that gives meaning to the world — tracing boundaries, organizing chaos, and allowing humans to inhabit a territory, physical, intellectual, or digital.

philosophyPillars.2: Map knowledge, do not accumulate it

About.title: From Chaos
About.description: NomosX is an autonomous think tank that maps evidence, challenges assumptions, and publishes positions anyone can verify — as a public good.
About.visionDesc: Four principles that define every publication NomosX produces.
About.vision1Desc: The world produces a flood of fragmented signals. NomosX structures the chaos into scenario-weighted, source-verified positions a decision-maker can defend — not just act on.
About.vision2Desc: The most consequential insights live at the intersection of domains. NomosX forces the collision across 250M+ sources and extracts the friction.
About.vision3Desc: Every claim links to its source. Every source to its DOI. Nothing is taken on faith. The map is the product; the sources are the terrain.
About.vision4Desc: Before producing a conclusion, NomosX establishes what the question actually means. A precise question poorly answered beats a vague one answered confidently.
About.value1Desc: Structure the noise into a causal chain anyone can follow.
About.value2Desc: Cartograph the intellectual territory — show where evidence is dense, absent, or contradictory.
About.value3Desc: We publish what we believe — with confidence bounds and stress-tested scenarios, not false balance.
About.value4Desc: A position worth defending emerges from source-verified, scenario-weighted evidence — not opinion or intuition.
About.missionStatement: Strategic decisions are still made on single forecasts, opaque sources, and borrowed convictions. We built an institute that does better — and runs 24/7.
About.howWeWorkDesc: One protocol. Four stages. No shortcuts. Every position follows the same pipeline — from mapping the evidence to stress-testing the conclusion.
About.whereWeWorkDesc: Eight domains, mapped together. The consequential insights live at the intersection — NomosX forces the collision.
About.theInstituteDesc: NomosX is not a team of analysts. It is an agentic system — 19 pipeline stages, 6 adversarial reviews, a metacognitive observer, and a process reward model that learns from every run. It never sleeps, never borrows convictions, and publishes every position with the receipts.
About.originText: NomosX was built on a single observation: the world doesn't suffer from a lack of information — it suffers from a lack of verifiable order. The Nomos is not merely the law. It is the order that gives meaning to the world — tracing boundaries, organizing chaos, and allowing humans to inhabit a territory, physical, intellectual, or digital.

Methodology.title: From chaos to nomos.
Methodology.whatSeparatesUs: What separates us from a summary
Methodology.standardsDesc: A summary aggregates. NomosX legislates — every claim on trial, every scenario stress-tested, every source traceable.
Methodology.standard1Text: Every [SRC-N] validated against available sources — no claim without a verdict.
Methodology.standard2Text: Full pipeline lineage stored per inquiry. Every step is reproducible.
Methodology.standard3Text: Minimum provider spread enforced at rank stage — no single-source monopoly.
Methodology.standard4Text: Adversarial challenge runs before every publication. Scenarios stress-tested, not asserted.
Methodology.intro: Four stages. No shortcuts. Chaos in, nomos out — a position worth defending, with the receipts.
Methodology.mapDesc: We pull from 250M+ sources across every relevant domain — academic research, institutional positions, primary data. We don't accumulate sources — we map the intellectual territory, showing where evidence is dense, where it's absent, and where it contradicts itself.
Methodology.confrontDesc: Every claim is challenged. Every assumption attacked. We force the strongest counter-argument before we let any position stand. The friction is the point — it's where certainty goes to get tested.
Methodology.quantifyDesc: Not one forecast. Multiple futures, each with a probability. Because the world doesn't move in straight lines — and decisions shouldn't either. We structure the uncertainty, not just the answer.
Methodology.decideDesc: A clear position, with the confidence to back it. Sources visible. Doubts logged. Scenarios stress-tested. The map, not just the terrain — everything you need to brief a room or sign a decision.

TrackRecord.title: Track Record
TrackRecord.description: Every prediction we publish is dated, falsifiable, and resolved in public. Judge us on our calls — not our prose.
TrackRecord.hitRateNote: Hit rate = confirmed / (confirmed + refuted). Expired ({expired}) and superseded ({superseded}) predictions are shown but excluded. Brier score measures probability calibration on {quantifiedResolved} quantified resolved predictions — 0 is perfect, 0.25 is chance-level.
TrackRecord.noPredictions: No predictions registered yet. Strategic reports produce falsifiable predictions — they will appear here, dated and immutable, as they are published.
TrackRecord.openPredictionsHold: Open predictions — hold us to these

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1Body: NomosX SAS operates the NomosX platform at nomosx.com. We are committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the GDPR and applicable French law. Data controller: NomosX SAS — contact: privacy@nomosx.com
Privacy.s2Account: Account data: email address, name, hashed password
Privacy.s2Usage: Usage data: research queries, brief views, session activity
Privacy.s2Newsletter: Newsletter data: email address, subscription status, confirmation date
Privacy.s2Billing: Billing data: processed by Stripe — we do not store card numbers
Privacy.s2Technical: Technical data: IP address (for rate limiting), browser type
Privacy.s3Item1: To provide and improve the Service
Privacy.s3Item2: To send transactional emails (account confirmation, weekly dispatch)
Privacy.s3Item3: To process subscription payments via Stripe
Privacy.s3Item4: To prevent abuse and enforce rate limits
Privacy.s3Note: We do not sell your data to third parties. We do not use your data to train AI models.
Privacy.s4Contract: Contract performance: account management, service delivery
Privacy.s4Legitimate: Legitimate interest: security, fraud prevention, analytics
Privacy.s5Body: Account data is retained for the duration of your account plus 3 years after deletion. Newsletter data is retained until you unsubscribe, then deleted within 30 days. Usage logs are retained for 12 months.
Privacy.s6OpenAI: OpenAI — AI model inference (data not used for training)
Privacy.s7Intro: Under GDPR, you have the right to:
Privacy.s7Item6: Withdraw consent at any time (newsletter: unsubscribe link in every email)
Privacy.s7Note: To exercise these rights, email privacy@nomosx.com. We respond within 30 days.
Privacy.s8Body: We use a single session cookie (nomosx-session) for authentication. It is httpOnly, secure, and expires after 7 days. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
Privacy.s9Body: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt (12 rounds). All connections use TLS. API routes are protected with CSRF validation and rate limiting. We conduct regular security audits.
Privacy.s10Body: Data protection inquiries: privacy@nomosx.com. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés) at cnil.fr.

Formats.signalBriefDesc: Rigorous alert on a verified signal, policy move, or emerging evidence shift. What happened, why it matters, what to watch. 500-1,200 words.
Formats.decisionMemoDesc: Structured decision brief for policy makers and executives — context, key evidence, options, recommendation, risks. 1,200-2,500 words.
Formats.articleDesc: Long-form analytical article — data-driven, narrative, rigorous. Multiple perspectives, what the evidence says. 3,000-6,000 words.
Formats.strategicReportDesc: Comprehensive strategic analysis with scenarios, stakeholder impact, recommendations, and implementation roadmap. 8,000-20,000 words.
